PR Summary by Qodo

Add mechanical hosted-review reading and resolve mission 22 findings 🐞 Bug fix ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 40+ Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add a hosted-review command that archives bot comments and detects findings edited in place.
>• Fix review recovery, phone commands, job IDs, project setup, and architect handbook access.
>• Align builder and reviewer protocols with the new workflow and add regression coverage.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD CLI["Hands CLI"] --> Hosted["Hosted review"] --> GH["GitHub API"] Hosted --> Archive[("Review archive")] --> Reviewer["Review protocol"] Daemon["Hands daemon"] --> Playbook["Playbook engine"] --> Phone["Phone channel"] ```
High-Level Assessment

>The following are alternative approaches to this PR:
1. Stage review snapshots before publishing them
- ➕ An archive-write failure would not leave an incomplete numbered snapshot that a later run treats as its predecessor. - ➖ Requires temporary-directory handling and atomic promotion, adding complexity to a command that already fetches all pages before writing.
>**Recommendation:** Keep the explicit paginated fetch and Code Review comment as the verdict source: both match the documented bot behavior, including in-place edits. Consider atomic snapshot publication before relying on the archive as durable review evidence; the current command creates its numbered directory before writing every file.

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
